office_description.name: Steward House
office_description.building_access: Use the Steward House lobby intercom. Facilities cupboard keys are held by the office manager in reception drawer R2.
office_description.emergency_rule: Do not ask staff to work on live electrical equipment, open a fuse board cover, use ladders, or bypass a safety interlock. Escalate immediately when there is smoke, heat, water near electricity, a burning smell, or uncertainty.

floors.description: Single office floor with reception, open-plan desks, kitchen and three meeting rooms.

areas.name: Reception
areas.position: South entrance, immediately after the lifts
areas.notes: Contains visitor sign-in tablet, spare access cards and the office-manager desk. First-aid kit is in the labelled cabinet behind the desk.

areas.name: Open-plan desks
areas.position: Centre and east side of Level 7
areas.notes: Thirty hot desks arranged in zones A, B and C. Each zone has ten desks, floor boxes and one network access point. Desk labels run A01-A10, B01-B10 and C01-C10.

areas.name: Kitchen
areas.position: North-west corner, beside the fire door
areas.notes: Coffee machine, dishwasher, fridge, filtered-water tap and the electrical cupboard. Keep the fire-door route clear.

areas.name: Meeting Room Atlas
areas.notes: Eight-person room. One 65-inch display, Logitech Rally Bar, HDMI cable and room-panel tablet.

areas.name: Meeting Room Birch
areas.position: North side, next to the kitchen
areas.notes: Four-person room. One 55-inch display, USB-C dock and room-panel tablet.

areas.name: Meeting Room Cedar
areas.position: East side, by desk zone C
areas.notes: Six-person room. One 55-inch display, USB-C dock and room-panel tablet.

areas.name: Comms cupboard
areas.notes: Holds internet modem, firewall, network switch and spare toner. Access is restricted to the managed-IT supplier or office manager.

office_rules: Office manager may reset a labelled circuit breaker once only when there is no smell of burning, water or visible damage.
Never unplug the firewall, network switch or meeting-room equipment without checking the inventory record and notifying the office manager.
Spare printer toner is in the lower shelf of the comms cupboard; recycle empty cartridges in the labelled box.
Plant watering happens on Mondays and Thursdays; use the filtered-water tap, not coffee-machine cleaning water.

employees.name: Nikolaj Jensen
employees.description: Owns day-to-day office operations, supplier approvals, room bookings and the facilities budget. Primary decision maker for escalations.

employees.name: Aisha Rahman
employees.description: Supports reception, visitor access, lunch orders and meeting-room resets. Safe first responder for routine kitchen and printer issues.

employees.name: Maya Patel
employees.description: Owns internal IT standards and liaises with managed IT. Can confirm service impact but should not be pulled into routine facilities fixes.

employees.name: Sam Clarke
employees.description: Coordinates staff communications, dietary requirements and new-starter equipment requests.

employees.name: Leo Martin
employees.description: Frequent meeting-room user and designated reporter for display or video-conferencing faults.

employees.name: Jess Wong
employees.description: Checks supplier invoices and budget codes. Requires a complete ticket and supplier brief before approving an unexpected charge.

escalation_contacts.name: BrightSpark Electricians
escalation_contacts.contract_terms: Four-hour weekday response. Authorisation from Nikolaj required before dispatch.
escalation_contacts.warranty_notes: Electrical remedial work completed in March 2026 has a 12-month warranty.

escalation_contacts.name: Northstar Managed IT
escalation_contacts.contract_terms: Remote support included. On-site visit is chargeable after remote diagnostics; attach firewall and access-point logs.
escalation_contacts.warranty_notes: Network equipment is covered by the managed-service agreement.

escalation_contacts.name: BeanWorks Coffee Service
escalation_contacts.contract_terms: Quarterly service included; call-outs for user-serviceable grinder jams should be avoided unless the error persists after cleaning.

escalation_contacts.name: Verdant Office Plants
escalation_contacts.contract_terms: Fortnightly Thursday visit. Extra rescue visit available within two business days.
escalation_contacts.warranty_notes: Replacement plants are covered for 30 days.

escalation_contacts.name: Vision Install Co.
escalation_contacts.contract_terms: Book five business days ahead; include delivery note, wall type and room availability.
escalation_contacts.warranty_notes: Installation labour is warrantied for 12 months.

inventory.name: Kitchen coffee machine
inventory.location: Kitchen, north counter beside filtered-water tap

service_history.summary: Quarterly clean and brew-group inspection; no faults.
Grinder jam cleared after hopper overfilled; staff guidance added.

safe_staff_actions: Empty bean hopper to approximately two-thirds
Run the on-screen grinder-cleaning cycle
Wipe visible dry grounds from hopper opening
escalate_when: Error persists after one cleaning cycle
There is a burning smell or unusual heat
known_issues: Grinder can jam when the hopper is filled to the brim or oily beans are used.

inventory.name: Kitchen dishwasher
inventory.location: Kitchen, under the south counter beside the recycling bins
visual_identifiers: E24 error shown in white characters
safe_staff_actions: Turn off using the front power button
Remove and rinse the accessible drain filter
Run the short rinse cycle after refitting the filter
escalate_when: Filter or pump cover is damaged
known_issues: E24 normally indicates a blocked accessible drain filter after busy lunch days.

inventory.name: Kitchen consumer unit
inventory.location: Kitchen, labelled electrical cupboard left of the fridge
visual_identifiers: Kitchen Sockets circuit is third breaker from left

service_history.summary: Kitchen sockets RCBO replaced by BrightSpark under warranty.
One circuit trip caused by an overfilled coffee-machine water tray; reset and monitored.

safe_staff_actions: Visually identify the labelled Kitchen Sockets breaker
Reset it once only if it is down and there is no sign of danger
Unplug the most recently used portable appliance before retrying if known
escalate_when: There is water, smoke, heat, damage or a burning smell
The affected breaker cannot be identified with certainty
known_issues: Kitchen Sockets supplies the coffee machine and counter outlets; it does not supply the dishwasher.

inventory.name: Main-floor Wi-Fi access point
inventory.location: Ceiling above desk zone B, near desk B05

service_history.summary: Firmware update applied by Northstar; intermittent roaming issue resolved.

safe_staff_actions: Confirm whether the issue affects desk zones A, B or C
Check the network-status page
Ask the office manager before power-cycling the labelled PoE injector
escalate_when: More than one access point is offline
Firewall, modem or comms cupboard equipment is involved
known_issues: The blue LED may be off during a firmware update; do not power-cycle until Northstar confirms status.

inventory.name: Reception printer
inventory.location: Reception, cabinet beside the office-manager desk
visual_identifiers: magenta toner indicator on front panel

service_history.summary: Cyan cartridge replaced; print queue test completed.

safe_staff_actions: Use the matching labelled spare cartridge
Follow on-screen replacement guide
Resume the queue and print one test page
escalate_when: A paper jam cannot be removed without force
The printer reports a fuser or hardware error
known_issues: Printer is leased; toner is included and should not create a separate call-out charge.

inventory.name: Meeting Room Birch display

service_history.summary: HDMI cable replaced after intermittent signal loss.

safe_staff_actions: Check that the wall control has power
Reconnect the labelled HDMI cable
Try the USB-C dock with a second laptop
known_issues: Do not remove the display from its wall mount; installation supplier is required for that work.

inventory.name: Open-plan plants
inventory.location: Desk zones A and C, reception and Meeting Room Birch

service_history.summary: Two pothos replaced after holiday watering gap.

safe_staff_actions: Check soil moisture one finger deep
Water dry plants lightly with filtered water
Move leaves away from direct heater airflow
escalate_when: More than one plant has yellowing leaves
known_issues: Planter beside desk C10 dries fastest because of the nearby air vent.

memory.lesson: For Jura X8 grinder-jammed errors, reducing the bean hopper to around two-thirds and running the cleaning cycle cleared the fault in under ten minutes. Do not call BeanWorks unless the error persists after one cycle.

The Kitchen Sockets breaker can be reset once when there is no safety warning. If it immediately trips again, leave it off and contact BrightSpark; the circuit was repaired in March 2026 and remains under warranty.
E24 has twice been resolved by clearing the accessible drain filter after lunch. The short rinse cycle should drain normally afterward.
Before escalating, establish the affected desk zones and consult the network-status page. A firmware update can temporarily turn the access-point LED off, so never power-cycle it blindly.
For Thursday lunch, start from the Green Bowl Kitchen order: 18 regular bowls, 3 vegan bowls, 2 gluten-free bowls and no peanuts. Sam owns dietary confirmation before an order is submitted.

history.title: Kitchen sockets tripped
history.outcome: Kitchen Sockets breaker was reset once after safety check. Coffee-machine water tray was emptied and no repeat trip occurred.

history.title: Jura X8 reports grinder jammed
history.outcome: Hopper was reduced to two-thirds and the grinder-cleaning cycle completed. Error cleared.

history.title: Intermittent Wi-Fi in desk zone B
history.outcome: Network status and access-point logs sent to Northstar. Supplier applied firmware update remotely; service stabilised.

history.title: Reception printer toner low
history.outcome: Cyan cartridge replaced from labelled spare stock and test page printed. Lease includes toner.

history.title: Dishwasher displays E24
history.outcome: Accessible drain filter was rinsed and refitted. Short rinse cycle drained normally.

history.title: Yellowing plants near desk C10
history.outcome: Plants were watered and two pothos replaced by Verdant after a missed holiday check.

history.title: New display installed in Meeting Room Birch
history.outcome: Vision Install Co. mounted replacement display, tested USB-C dock and removed packaging. Room was blocked for the appointment.

invoices.notes: Firmware remediation included in managed-service agreement.
Extra rescue visit matched the contracted call-out cost.
Screen-installation call-out matched quote and completed ticket.

playbooks.name: Critical electrical report
playbooks.trigger: Tripped breaker, no power, electrical smell or visible electrical damage
steps: Only reset one clearly labelled breaker once when safe
Escalate on any repeat trip or uncertainty

playbooks.name: Supplier escalation brief
steps: Include access instructions and approval contact
State expected call-out cost before sending
